description.en: Experimental setup for YDSE showing monochromatic light passing through two narrow slits $S_1$ and $S_2$, producing an interference pattern on the screen.
description.hi: YDSE के लिए प्रायोगिक व्यवस्था जो दो संकीर्ण स्लिटों $S_1$ और $S_2$ से गुजरने वाले एकवर्णी प्रकाश को दर्शाती है, जिससे पर्दे पर व्यतिकरण प्रतिरूप उत्पन्न होता है।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Light Source -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="150" r="5" fill="#f59e0b" />
  <text x="25" y="170" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">S</text>
  <!-- Wavefronts from S -->
  <path d="M50,110 Q65,150 50,190" fill="none" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5" />
  <path d="M70,90 Q95,150 70,210" fill="none" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5" />

  <!-- Double Slit Barrier -->
  <rect x="120" y="20" width="10" height="100" fill="#4b5563" />
  <rect x="120" y="130" width="10" height="40" fill="#4b5563" />
  <rect x="120" y="180" width="10" height="100" fill="#4b5563" />

  <!-- Slit Labels -->
  <text x="100" y="128" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">S₁</text>
  <text x="100" y="188" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">S₂</text>

  <!-- Distance d between slits -->
  <line x1="140" y1="125" x2="140" y2="175" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2,2" />
  <text x="145" y="155" font-family="Arial" font-size="12">d</text>

  <!-- Screen -->
  <rect x="400" y="20" width="10" height="260" fill="#9ca3af" />
  <text x="420" y="155" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">Screen</text>

  <!-- Distance D -->
  <line x1="130" y1="280" x2="400" y2="280" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="130" y1="275" x2="130" y2="285" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="400" y1="275" x2="400" y2="285" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="260" y="295" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">D</text>

  <!-- Central axis -->
  <line x1="125" y1="150" x2="400" y2="150" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="5,5" />
  <text x="415" y="155" font-family="Arial" font-size="12">O</text>

  <!-- Rays to a point P on screen -->
  <line x1="130" y1="125" x2="400" y2="70" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="130" y1="175" x2="400" y2="70" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <circle cx="400" cy="70" r="3" fill="#10b981" />
  <text x="415" y="75" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">P</text>

  <!-- Distance y -->
  <line x1="380" y1="150" x2="380" y2="70" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2,2" />
  <text x="365" y="115" font-family="Arial" font-size="12">y</text>

  <!-- Interference Pattern (Illustrative) -->
  <path d="M405,150 Q430,150 405,130 Q430,130 405,110 Q430,110 405,90 Q430,90 405,70" fill="none" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2" />
  <path d="M405,150 Q430,150 405,170 Q430,170 405,190 Q430,190 405,210 Q430,210 405,230" fill="none" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2" />

</svg>
